summary: Added hollow bus cabins with visible seats and transparent glazing, deterministic individual warm/cool/dark night bays, restrained paint roughness and four base pigments, real wheel openings and circular hubs. Retained cheap wheels and light cues at distance. Added shelter timetable rows and line-number geometry, and reframed existing owned stops and bus heroes without modifying props. Continuous routing, real-occupant demand, private drafts and save behavior remain unchanged and pass fresh checks. Visual quality is improved but remains below target.
acceptanceMet: Final 16-camera/time gauntlet and 11 transit preset captures are ready with zero errors; the empty owner startup also has zero errors.
Fresh owner API checks pass 24/24, integration seam checks 9/9, geometry/render quality checks 9/9 and actual population refresh checks 6/6.
Continuous cached junctions retain pure hour-based deterministic motion, exact eight-second scheduled dwells and exact ordinary lane poses outside junctions.

Private draft cancel and validation are atomic; a valid commit emits once; zero fleet serializes a JSON-safe null headway and restores runtime Infinity; exact legacy empty-object saves clear outgoing transit.
Actual zero occupants produce zero riders. Positive simulation occupancy changes cached demand with one completed event batch and no owner treasury mutation.
Stable owner attribution matches actual group deltas at 15 to 20 calls including shadows and night layers; maximum observed owned geometry is 147148 triangles. Off-camera owned draws are zero.
Transit owns no DOM output. Geometry chips retain measured 21 pixel height and HUD exclusion at 720p; line ribbons, chevrons and white stop rings remain intact.

Day paint roughness is 0.38. Source and surface diagnostics show multiple night bay tints and a dark bay; day light emission is zero. This is a partial material improvement, not full night photometry acceptance.
All five owned source files have exact byte copies and SHA256 manifests for both r2 and r3.
acceptanceMissed: 1. Full visual and literal image hard gates remain below target despite zero final runtime errors.
3. Vehicle form and materials improve but the front remains too simple and the literal pinned pixel requirement fails.
6. Night body contrast and all requested numeric lighting ratios remain missed or unestablished.
17. Literal all-object shadow flags remain missed; precise ground contact and shadow azimuth are not measured.
LOD: the isolated two-metre transition image threshold is unestablished; raw comparison is confounded.
remainingWeaknesses: Below the 8.5 visual target. The front and roof remain boxy, seats are simple rectangles and the destination display still says BUS rather than the actual line destination.

Night windows have distinct warm, cool and dark bays, but the gray night body remains too bright. A projected 12 pixel body patch has median luminance 108.23; sampled warm and cool windows are 164.83 and 168.23. The requested body/window contrast, peak brightness and shelter bench light ratio are not established as passing.

Literal pinned bus pixel excess still fails: day maximum 109.60 with 2037 pixels above 40; night maximum 132.59 with 1655 pixels above 40. These rectangles include geometry edges, foliage and traffic, so the result is not proof of paint sparkle everywhere.

The bus hero fits the 1920 pixel HUD-safe frame within 12 metres, and shelter views expose the bench and timetable. A narrow day foreground pole still overlaps the bus; street framing retains foliage on the right. Far routes still lose clarity behind foliage.

Wheels and essential window/headlamp cues now survive the 180 metre transition. Secondary details and doors still disappear. The 179/181 metre raw crop comparison changes 35.06 percent of pixels above 6 RGB, but moving ambient traffic and camera/background parallax confound it; the isolated 1.5 percent LOD requirement remains unestablished.

Structural body and wheels cast shadows, but glass, lamp, door and shelter-glass batches do not all cast them. Literal all-object shadow acceptance remains missed. Shelter bench/timetable wash approximates local bounce with a material emissive attribute.

The composed all showcase costs 530 draws and 3,239,923 triangles at 22.4 fps on Apple M4 Metal. This is a whole-game observation during neighbour democity changes, not an isolated transit regression; it exceeds the desired scene triangle ceiling.

No articulated tram stretch. The owner still uses one deterministic own fleet because the traffic API does not provide a complete managed fleet contract. Native tool and treasury consumer integration remains root-owned and was unapplied during these captures.
The user stop boundary ends development after this current round and integration. No r4 or new development scope is started.

measurementLimitations: The quality probe loaded before the final palette-only adjustment. Geometry, shader structure, path behavior and draw counts were unchanged by that adjustment; final gauntlet, presets and surface captures use the final palette.
Bus hero selection can choose different actual vehicles at different hours, so day/night panel sample differences are not solely a lighting comparison.
Projected material samples are approximate 12 by 12 patches, not isolated object/material masks. Border and background contamination is retained explicitly.
No new pure graph unit fixture was run in this round. Fresh actual-browser graph probes pass, and graph source is byte-identical to r2.
Independent critic evidence is excluded from builder image and metric enumeration.
